head_commit.message:
codex: wire startup memory extraction and consolidation (#11208)

## Summary
- wire startup memory phase-1 extraction into `Session` startup flow
- persist phase-1 outputs and schedule per-cwd consolidation subagents
- add phase progress logs and consolidation lock
release-on-agent-completion flow
- set consolidation subagent cwd to memory root to align workspace-write
permissions
- extract memory startup/consolidation implementation into
`core/src/codex/memory_startup.rs` to keep `codex.rs` thinner

## Testing
- just fmt
- cargo test -p codex-core --lib memories::
- cargo test -p codex-core --lib
codex::tests::resumed_history_seeds_initial_context_on_first_turn_only
